name: Barbarian Royalty Worshiping the Buddha
material: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Painting section: 28.6 x 103.5 cm (11 1/4 x 40 3/4 in.); Overall with colophon: 28.6 x 667.7 cm (11 1/4 x 262 7/8 in.)
summary: This painting begins on the right with 15 people following a dignified figure wearing headgear with twin pheasant feathers.
